definition:
### Reconciliation control flow

The client polls until observed and desired states agree:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Reconcile invoked]) --> Describe[Describe observed state]
    Describe --> Compare{Replicas match?}
    Compare -- yes --> Done([Return success])
    Compare -- no --> Attempts{Attempts exhausted?}
    Attempts -- no --> Backoff[Sleep 0.25k seconds]
    Backoff --> Describe
    Attempts -- yes --> Fail([Raise timeout])
```

Backoff is linear rather than exponential to bound total latency.
